To find the TV series, I will first identify Turkish TV series that were released between 1990 and 2005, focusing on those that are comedies. Then, I will look for a lead actress from one of these series who performed in a theatre play between 1980 and 1990. I will also check if the root word of the play's name is similar in meaning to the first word of the series. Finally, I will confirm that the series aired on two different channels. 

Let's start by listing Turkish comedy series from that time period.
